name: Saint Spell's Love Guide to the Magical Student's Handbook
source:
“Welcome, welcome, and welcome to the wonderful Saint Spell~♡ The magical Conservatory with secrets abound~"
“There're mysterious witches, friendly anima, angelic Seraphims, devilish Fiendish, and beautiful Clockhearts aplenty!”
“Dance and sing your heart's fill! Love them, hate them, befriend them all~”

Join us in our special Valentine’s day release of Saint Spell’s very own dating simulator! In your first week of school, meet 29 magical students, practice some special spells, brew a love potion, or simply slack off…

[From [url=https://jiefinch.itch.io/saintspell]Itch.io[/url]]

Based on the online roleplaying group [url=https://www.deviantart.com/saintspell]Saint Spell[/url].
translation:
“欢迎欢迎欢迎来到美妙的圣咒～♡充满秘密的魔法温室～”
“这里有神秘的女巫、友好的阿尼玛、天使般的六翼天使、恶魔般的恶魔和美丽的钟心！”
“尽情地跳舞、唱歌吧！爱他们、恨他们、和他们成为朋友~”

加入我们在情人节特别发布的Saint Spell专属约会模拟器！在开学第一周，结识29位魔法学生，练习一些特殊咒语，酿造爱情药水，或者干脆偷懒……

[来自[url=https://jiefinch.itch.io/saintspell]Itch.io[/url]]

基于在线角色扮演小组 [url=https://www.deviantart.com/saintspell]Saint Spell[/url]。
